## Biography
Omijeh David Odianonsen (Odia / Tech Monarch) is a 19-year-old hybrid founder-engineer from Port Harcourt, Nigeria.
He started coding at age 9-10 under the influence of his father, Professor Omijeh Bourdillon Odianonsen (University of Port Harcourt, Engineering).
In 2024, he founded Pantheon Venture Studio — a structured system for building, validating, and scaling AI-native startups.
He has built 11+ products across AI, EdTech, GovTech, Fintech, and consumer technology.
His core belief: "I was meant to build systems that leave a permanent mark on history."
